references.text: Several kings gathered to fight against Joshua and Israel, a similar coalition against God's people
Northern kings gathered together to fight against Israel, the same pattern of hostile alliance
Enemies gathered against Israel during the time of the judges, continuing resistance against God's people
Kings and rulers gather against the Lord and his anointed, prophesying about enemies uniting against God
Nations form alliances together against Israel with one mind, similar unified opposition
Fulfillment of Psalm 2 - the kings of the earth and their rulers gathered against the Lord and his Christ
